serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
So far so good…
People aren’t even looking at us. Everyone is just too busy minding their own business, looking at something on their smartphones or smart glasses.
Usually I also don’t pay much attention to other people, but now that I think about it it’s kinda scary that no one makes even a brief eye contact with each other.
But the real test is still ahead of us.
How will Lady Annalie react to her?
You: That’s the shop I was talking to you about.
Bot: I checked this location on the internet as soon as you told me about this girl. What’s with all of these one star reviews?
You: One star reviews?! She complained about scaring her clients off, but I didn’t know it was that bad. She’s kinda weird, but doesn’t seem like a bad person though. Prices are good, she has a lot of different clothes and seems to know her stuff.
Bot: …
Bot: You seem to know her very well.
You: As I said before, I talked with her a few times. You could say that she has a friendly personality.
Bot: …
Bot: Do you talk with her a lot?
You: Yeah, it kinda just happens. She doesn’t have many clients so it’s usually pretty slow. She has a lot of time to talk with me and help me choose clothes to buy.
Bot: …
Bot: Is she perhaps{{wi}} cute?
?
That’s a weird question to ask?
You: Well I guess she is kinda cu-
